slides.title: Every Pakistani fuels more than just their vehicle
slides.brief:
Create a modern, minimalistic 3D presentation slide with emotional storytelling:
BACKGROUND: White base with warm gradient (white to very light gold #FFF9E6) on right side. Left side: 3D illustration of Pakistani delivery rider on motorcycle (3D rendered, PSO green uniform, semi-realistic style). Rider should look determined, professional, relatable. Subtle motion blur on wheels suggesting movement. Background: Abstract Pakistani cityscape silhouette (simplified geometric shapes).
3D ELEMENTS: Fuel drops floating around the rider transforming into: Food icons (biryani plate, roti, vegetables), Money symbols, University cap, Family icons. Smooth particle effects connecting fuel to these symbols. All in PSO green and gold colors. Frosted glass material on floating elements.
TEXT OVERLAY (Right side): Main Headline (Large, Bold, Dark Grey): "Every Pakistani Fuels More Than Just Their Vehicle" Subheading (PSO Green): "THE CULTURAL INSIGHT" Three insight boxes (Stacked vertically, clean cards): Box 1 (with small motorcycle icon): "When a rider fills his tank, he's not buying petrol. He's buying his family's dinner." Box 2 (with student cap icon): "When a student fuels her bike, she's not buying mobility. She's buying her future." Box 3 (with car icon): "When a father fills the car, he's not buying liters. He's buying memories with his kids." Bottom callout (Large, Gold background): "Pakistanis aren't looking for borrowed prestige. They're looking for recognition that their sacrifice matters."
STYLE: Emotional, human-centered, warm tones, professional 3D illustration. MOOD: Empathetic, culturally grounded, authentic.
